**"Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002"**
https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-002

This record is for a *different* Christian Hole — born **1852 in Norway**, wife Bergit, son Nils, residing in Aurdal, Otter Tail County. Christian P. Hole was born in 1875, making him only about 10 years old in 1885 — he could not have been the head of this household. The same record is already attached to **KD96-WX7** (Christian Hole, born 1852 Norway, died 1919 Aurdal), whose profile fits perfectly.

**Next step:** Detach this source from KD96-TV2. It belongs to KD96-WX7.

https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-001

---

**Hole family photograph and funeral card (uploaded memory)** — a user upload with no readable record ID.

---

### Additional Flags (from FamilySearch's own checklist)
- The **marriage has no tagged sources**.
- A **marriage place** is missing a city.
- Several places on the person are not linked to a standard place.

---

**"Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002"**
[https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-002](https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-002)

**"Minnesota State Census, 1885"**
[https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-003](https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-003)

The indexed household shows a Christian born **1852** in Norway, with a wife Bergit (b. 1856) and a son Nils (b. 1879, Minnesota), at Aurdal, Otter Tail. Christian P. Hole was born **1875** — 23 years off, far beyond census drift. A man born in 1875 cannot have a son born in 1879. This record belongs to a different **Christian Hole (KD96-WX7)**, whose profile matches: born 1852 Norway, resident Aurdal, Otter Tail in 1885, died 1919 at Aurdal.

**Action:** **Detach this source from Christian P. Hole's profile.** It belongs to KD96-WX7, not KD96-TV2.

---

### No Finding
**"United States Census, 1900"**
[https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-001](https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-001)

Fairview Township residence matches the profile. The birth year shows 1877 vs. the profile's 1875 — normal census drift, not flagged.

**"Hole family photograph and funeral card (uploaded memory)"**
[https://ancestors.familysearch.org/en/KD96-TV2/memories](https://ancestors.familysearch.org/en/KD96-TV2/memories)

---

- The **marriage has no tagged sources**.
- A **marriage place is missing a city**.

---

**Summary:** Detach the 1885 Minnesota census (Finding 2 — wrong person entirely). Verify the death year against the original certificate to resolve the 1954 vs. 1945 discrepancy (Finding 1).

Here is the source-evaluation agent's audit of Cornelius Driscoll (GJ72-9WD), findings worst first:

---

## Sources on Cornelius Driscoll (GJ72-9WD) — 7 attached, 2 user-actionable findings

---

### 1. ⚠️ Source-vs-Source Conflict — Death Date (route to conflict-resolution)

**Quebec, Catholic Parish Registers, 1621–1979** (burial) vs. **Quebec, Civil Registration Deaths, 1867–1900**

- The **burial record** gives death/burial in **April 1878**, St. Patrick's Cemetery, Sherbrooke.
- The **civil death index** gives death **2 February 1885**, Sherbrooke.
- These are seven years apart. Both are exact-date records naming Sherbrooke.
- The profile has no death date recorded.
- **Action:** Take this pair to conflict-resolution; do not detach either source. A headstone photograph (uploaded memory, SD-DRIS-F) may resolve this, but it must be read first.

---

### 2. 🔧 Indexing/Transcription Error — Marriage Date

**Quebec, Vital and Church Records (Drouin Collection), 1621–1968**

- Indexed marriage date: **9 June 1845**, St. Patrick's, Sherbrooke.
- Profile records: **9 June 1849**, Sherbrooke.
- The couple (Cornelius Driscoll & Margaret Hayes) and parish match; only the year disagrees.
- **Action:** Re-read the original register page (images are available in this collection) to confirm the year, then correct the index on FamilySearch. Keep the source attached.

---

### 3. ❓ Ambiguous — Indexing Error or Misattribution — 1851 Residence

**Census of Canada East, 1851**

- Indexed residence: **Melbourne**, Canada East; birthplace Ireland.
- Profile records residence: **Sherbrooke**, Canada East.
- No age, household, or spouse in the index to corroborate.
- **Action:** Re-read the census enumeration and check the place and surrounding household before deciding whether to keep or detach. Do not detach on this evidence alone.

---

### Not checkable
- **Uploaded headstone photograph** (SD-DRIS-F): contributor upload with no indexed record — useful as a lead for the death-date conflict, but not evidence until read.

### Sourcing gap
- No death date is entered on the profile despite a civil death entry being attached.

### Impossible-date flag
- One place on the person is not linked to a standard place (tree-level warning).

---

The audit has been logged to the research log as **log_001**.

Here is the source-evaluation agent's report on **Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2)**:

---

## Sources Audited: 4 sources — 2 findings

---

### Finding 1 — Indexing Error (keep, correct)
**"Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002"**
https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-002

The indexed death date is **10 June 1954**, but the profile records **10 June 1945**. All other fields (name, birth year 1875, Norway, place of death Erskine, Polk, Minnesota) fit this man. This is a transcription error in the index, not a misattribution.

**Action:** Re-read the original death certificate, then correct the indexed date through FamilySearch's correction path. Keep the source attached — it is good evidence with one bad field.

---

### Finding 2 — Misattributed Source (detach)
**"Minnesota State Census, 1885"**
https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-003

The indexed person is a Christian born **1852** in Norway, living in Aurdal, Otter Tail County in 1885 with wife Bergit and son Nils. Christian P. Hole was born **1875**, had wife Inger, and son Ole C. — none of these match. This source is also attached to **KD96-WX7**, whose profile (b. 1852, Aurdal, d. 1919) fits the indexed record.

**Action:** Detach this source from Christian P. Hole; it belongs to KD96-WX7.

---

### Not a Finding
**"United States Census, 1900"** gives birth year 1877 vs. the profile's 1875 — a two-year census variance, well within normal range. Residence, wife, and son all match. No action needed.

---

### Could Not Check
**"Hole family photograph and funeral card" (memory upload)** — no readable record ID. The uploader title names a 1945 Erskine death, but titles are often copied from the tree and don't independently corroborate. Review the funeral card alongside the death certificate when addressing Finding 1.

---

### Tree Integrity Notes
- **Contradiction:** A residence event is dated 1950, more than 1 year after the recorded death of 10 June 1945. This needs to be resolved.
- **Implausible:** A place on this person is not linked to a standard place.

### Profile Checklist Gaps (FamilySearch suggestions)
- The marriage has no tagged sources.
- The marriage place is missing a city.

---

Here is the source-evaluation agent's full report on **Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2)**:

---

## Sources Audit — Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2)

4 sources checked · **2 findings**

---

### 1. ⚠️ Indexing Error — "Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002"
- **What's wrong:** The indexed death year is **1954**, but the profile records **10 June 1945**. All other fields (Erskine, Polk County; Norway birth; 1875) fit this person.
- **Action:** Retrieve the death certificate for the Christian P. Hole who died in Erskine, Polk County, in June 1945, and submit a correction through FamilySearch's index-correction path. **Keep the source attached** — it's good evidence with one bad field.

---

### 2. ❌ Misattributed Source — "Minnesota State Census, 1885"
- **What's wrong:** The indexed person is a Christian Hole born **1852** in Norway, residing in Aurdal, Otter Tail County, with wife **Bergit** (b. 1856) and son Nils (b. 1879). This does not match Christian P. Hole, who was born in 1875 with wife Inger — multiple fields disagree.
- **Who it belongs to:** This record also appears on **KD96-WX7** (a different Christian Hole, b. 1852, died in Aurdal 1919), where it correctly belongs.
- **Action:** **Detach this source** from Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2). It is misattributed.

---

### 3. ❓ Unverifiable — Uploaded Photograph/Funeral Card
- A contributor-uploaded memory (funeral card, Erskine, 1945) could not be read as a structured record. Its citation is plausible but unverified — worth examining alongside the death-year correction in Finding 1.

---

### Additional Notes
- **Profile warning:** One or more place values are not linked to a standard place.
- **FamilySearch suggestions (not errors):** The marriage has no tagged sources; the marriage place is missing a city.

---

The findings have been logged as **log_001** in the project's `research.json`.

Here is the source-evaluation report for **Cornelius Driscoll (GJ72-9WD)**:

---

## Sources Evaluated — 7 attached, 3 findings

### Finding 1 — Indexing Error (likely)
**Quebec, Vital and Church Records (Drouin Collection), 1621–1968**
- Indexed marriage date: **9 June 1845**; profile records **9 June 1849**
- Names and parish (St. Patrick's, Sherbrooke) agree — only the year differs.
- **Action:** Re-read the original Drouin marriage register entry and compare the year. Correct whichever field is wrong. Keep the source attached either way.

---

### Finding 2 — Indexing Error or Misattribution (cannot be determined from the profile alone)
**Census of Canada East, 1851**
- Indexed residence: **Melbourne, Canada East**; profile records **Sherbrooke, Canada East**
- Name and Irish birthplace agree; no age in the record to test further.
- **Action:** Re-read the 1851 census entry. Do not detach on current evidence alone.

---

### Finding 3 — Source-vs-Source Conflict on Death (seven-year gap)
Two sources directly contradict each other:
- **Quebec, Catholic Parish Registers** → burial **14 April 1878**, St. Patrick's Cemetery, Sherbrooke
- **Quebec, Civil Registration Deaths** → death **2 February 1885**, Sherbrooke

Both give birth 1814, Ireland. The profile has no death fact recorded. No winner has been chosen.
- **Action:** Take this to conflict resolution. Compare the original burial register image against the civil death record behind the 1885 index entry. The headstone photograph (uploaded memory, no record ID) may help as a lead only.

---

### Not a Finding — Noted
- **Christening record** (Skibbereen, Cork, 12 March 1814) agrees with birth year 1814 and refines birthplace from Ireland → Skibbereen. No problem.
- **1861 census** birth year of 1816 is typical census drift; excluded from concern.

---

### Impossible-Date Check
One implausibility flagged: a place on this person is not linked to a standard place (affects Birth 1814, Marriage 1849, Residence 1851, Residence 1861, Burial).

---
